repaired_review_findings: Existing falsy malformed project JSON must not be overwritten.
Write and read JSON limits must match.
Decoded JSON credential patterns must be checked before output.
Custom Agent homes must be shared between install and diagnosis.
Physical target aliases must not produce false duplicates.
Case, Unicode and short-name aliases must use directory identity for the same receipt and lock.
safety_contracts: Configuration contains hints, not execution authority; stored commands are never executed.
Checkpoints restore through the existing core and require fresh host revalidation.
Existing task history and observations cannot be silently removed or rewritten.
Locks and revisions guard cooperating writers; external edits require host reconciliation.
Receipt failure rolls back the attempted batch and preserves the original receipt.
Unknown or modified installations are reported, never automatically deleted.
Local state is ignored by Git by default and created with private file permissions where supported.
limits: Local macOS tests covered case-insensitive and Unicode path aliases. Windows 8.3 paths and Linux runtime were not tested on their respective operating systems in this turn.
No production/backends/hardware were accessed. No full live-model corpus or remote CI was run for this addition.
Automatic cross-session wakeup and native per-worker hard permission boundaries require host integration.
Receipts and checkpoints are local untrusted records, not cryptographic provenance or current authorization.
Current npm 0.10.1 predates these development changes; no new release was performed.
followup_note: Project convention adaptation changes the shared workspace safety references after this run. Preserve original hashes and results; they do not certify the new instructions.
